Bio:
I have always had a keen interest in health and wellness but it was not until a fateful conversation with my mother-in-law fifteen years ago that my interest became my career. I was restless in my management consulting job and she reminded me I had nothing to lose in jumping ship and joining my partner in his business. This sparked a journey into ownership of a successful chain of fitness studios and now another business that I'm truly passionate about - Your Reformer, a retailer of premium Pilates reformer beds for use in home and commercial settings.

How did my passion for Pilates ignite? I first tried Pilates during my difficult fertility journey - I work hard and love keeping busy and fit, but Pilates helped me find the balance I needed in my body and mind. After receiving my qualification, I shared the benefits of this mindful movement practice with the members at our gyms. The classes were so successful we incorporated wellness studios in all our gyms and my focus turned to building my instructor team and an exceptional experience for our members. 

We sold the gyms in 2021 for over $6 million and had planned some family downtime with our second child on the way. However, Covid-19 impacts continued and further lockdowns loomed. 

Itching for the next challenge, we saw an opportunity and developed premium Pilates reformer beds for people locked down and unable to get to their studio. Your Reformer delivers the full experience at home with beautiful beds and exceptional on-demand classes via app. Now servicing AU, NZ & the US DTC, and globally for B2B, the business is enjoying exponential growth.

The Your Reformer mission to share wellness and health with our loyal and empowered community is something I am grateful to work for every day.

We’re Sweat, the leading women’s fitness app and global community that’s transformed the lives of millions of women from Sydney to Singapore to San Diego.

Headline: CEO of One Playground & The Bunker.
Bio:
I am driven by the need to create a better way of doing things. Let me bore you with some stats:

Since the fitness explosion in the late 80's, obesity has more than tripled. Only 17% of Australians are gym members. And of this, less than half use it enough/efficiently in order to get meaningful results. As an industry, we are happy to accept that 50% of our members will quit each year. Madness. 

Switching to staff: The average tenure for a Personal Trainer is estimated at 6 months! Some companies have over 200%+ salary based employee turnover. Yet we are still "educating" tens of thousands of new trainers every year incorrectly, many via an 6-8 week online course. 

Whatever way we look at things, what we are doing right now is not working. There has to be a better way. An approach that consistently creates success for our people - members and staff. 

That is the mission I am on with One Playground. We are here to change the Gym Environment and Experience and ultimately create success for our Members and Staff. Our mission is to Inspire Change at all levels: Members, Staff & Industry.

How? We are exchanging Intimidation for Engagement & Education; Boredom for Experience & Fun; Isolation for Interaction & Community. We don't believe that the gym should only be a place for the already fit to get fitter. We believe the Environment and Experience should allow every Australian to feel comfort, a sense of belonging and be a source of inspiration. Well, that's the plan anyway. Wish us luck!

I was the kid that always annoyed my parents with....another great business idea.

YR has now expanded into New Zealand, and I’m currently leading our international expansion plans.
